description: Plugin-distributed hooks for graph-engineering. Paths use ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}. Advisory smell flags for unbounded paths, untyped relationships, and anonymous MATCH ()-.

hooks.command: /usr/bin/env -u BASH_ENV -u ENV -u SHELLOPTS -u BASHOPTS -u LD_PRELOAD -u LD_LIBRARY_PATH -u LD_AUDIT -u DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES -u DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH -u PYTHONPATH -u PYTHONSTARTUP PATH=/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin /bin/bash --noprofile --norc "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/flag-graph-smells.sh" "$CLAUDE_TOOL_FILE_PATH"
hooks.comment: Advisory: flags unbounded [*], untyped -[]-, and anonymous MATCH ()- in .cypher/.cyp/.gql/.sparql/.rq/.groovy/.py/.js/.ts/.md. Set GRAPH_SMELLS_STRICT=1 to block.
